shots.prompt: Pixar-style 3D animated film still: a huge flock of dozens of bright scarlet macaw parrots with red bodies and blue-and-gold wings wheeling and soaring together across a warm golden evening sky, the flock stretching across the whole frame, the dark smoke plume of the circus train rising at the edge of frame far below, no lettering anywhere, cinematic children's movie lighting
shots.beat: a huge flock of dozens of bright scarlet parrots wheeling across the warm golden evening sky above the train
must_not: a single lone bird or just a few birds
shots.animate: the camera is locked off and does not move; the parrots drift slowly across the sky with gentle wingbeats, the smoke plume rises softly
shots.clip_beat: bright scarlet parrots spread across the golden evening sky for the whole shot, wings beating as they drift

identity.subject: the scarlet macaw parrots (design match to the master)
